data.one_liner: A widget that provides a slide drawer with customizable animation and background.
data.what_it_does: It wraps a body and a drawer widget, allowing the drawer to slide in with optional rounded or rectangular effects. The drawer can be opened by dragging or programmatically via a key.
use_when: You need a custom slide drawer with animation and background image support.
You want RTL support without writing custom drawer logic.
avoid_when: You only need the standard Flutter Drawer widget.
You require complex navigation or state management beyond a simple drawer.
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single widget.
Customizable background image, color, and animation type.
weaknesses: Limited to drawer functionality; no navigation stack integration.
No theming or advanced state management features.
No support for nested drawers or complex gestures.
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import the package. No additional permissions or build_runner needed.
data.minimal_example:
```dart
SliderDrawerWidget(
  key: drawerKey,
  option: SliderDrawerOption(
    backgroundImage: Image.asset("assets/sample_background.jpg"),
    backgroundColor: Colors.black,
    sliderEffectType: SliderEffectType.Rounded,
    upDownScaleAmount: 50,
    radiusAmount: 50,
    direction: SliderDrawerDirection.LTR,
  ),
  drawer: CustomDrawer(),
  body: Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(),
    body: Container(),
  ),
)
```
